Definition: properly, to gasp; hence, to be exhausted, to tire, to toil
BiblicalUsage: Let not all the people go up, said the spies to Joshua, but let about two or three thousand men go up and smite Ai, and make not all the people to labour thither, and Eleazar smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe toil is the price of both stories: the men who would not labour at Ai and the hand that laboured until it stuck to the sword, and the Bible honours the weariness that stays in the fight.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
